description: A Claude-focused variant of Pixel Spectacles: a warm black-and-white pixel cat with yellow eyes, subtly adjusted black/white fur balance, and rows documented for Claude states such as thinking, tool use, permission waits, compacting, plan mode, and interruption.

stateContract.variantNotes: Reworked from the source pet with restrained charcoal fur, warm white fur, preserved yellow eyes, and a slight white-fur edge expansion to change the black/white balance without making the sprite feel purple.

idle.label: Idle
idle.description: Waiting for user input, no active task.

thinking.label: Thinking
thinking.description: Reasoning or analyzing before tool calls.

tool_use.label: Tool use
tool_use.description: Executing Read, Edit, Bash, Agent, or other tools.

waiting_for_permission.label: Waiting for permission
waiting_for_permission.description: Tool call needs user approval or permission-mode changes.

waiting_for_user_input.label: Waiting for user input
waiting_for_user_input.description: Blocked on an AskUserQuestion-style user reply.

background_task_running.label: Background task running
background_task_running.description: A bash/background monitor or async agent continues outside the main thread.

compacting.label: Compacting
compacting.description: Context is being summarized or compressed.

plan_mode.label: Plan mode
plan_mode.description: Read-only exploration and planning before execution.

interrupted.label: Interrupted / Stopped
interrupted.description: User interrupted with Esc or the task was stopped.
